user.title: Backend Butler
user.description: Connect your LiveKit project so the dashboard card can talk to your voice agent worker. Settings were filled in from an older install where one exists. Check them and submit.

data_description.agent_name: Must match AGENT_NAME in the worker's .env (default: ha-agent)
data_description.scheduler_url: Base URL of the scheduler service, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8951. Enables the Schedules tab.
data_description.scheduler_token: Must match SCHEDULER_TOKEN in the scheduler's .env; the scheduler refuses requests without it
data_description.chat_url: Base URL of the worker's HTTP app, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8952. Enables the Text tab.
data_description.chat_token: Must match TEXT_API_TOKEN in the worker's .env
data_description.music_url: Base URL of the music server, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8961. Adds a media player for the music it plays.
